title: Quaternion Interpolation
text: Quaternion interpolation between two quaternions, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Action for out-of-range input} sets Out-of-range block behavior; {Methods} sets the quaternion interpolation method. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Methods
params.values: Quaternion interpolation method SLERP (default) | LERP | NLERP

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior None (default) | Warning | Error
